title: TanStack Query provider
scope: 'use client' QueryProvider holding a QueryClient (staleTime 30s, refetchOnWindowFocus=false) in useState; wraps children in <QueryClientProvider>.

success_criteria.manual: Wrapped in root layout (T-031); useQuery hooks resolve without errors.
success_criteria.automated: Exercised indirectly when page tests render queries.
success_criteria.definition_of_done: Single 'use client' boundary; QueryClient memoised in useState (not module-level — avoids cross-request leaks in App Router).
